purpose: Test whether seven additional exact-W suffix carrier channels improve hidden-state reconstruction when channel zero starts at the exact fold-pure nonlinear-Z OOF function rather than the failed zero-output c8v1 initialization.

fold_pure_initialization.rule: For each fold, deterministically rerun the frozen nonlinear-Z train_fixed recipe on the other 516 rows with the original stream id equal to the fold.
fold_pure_initialization.required_reconstruction_check: Before C8 adaptation, the reconstructed fold model's held172 per-network MSE vector must match the persisted nonlinear-Z OOF authority with maximum absolute difference at most 5e-20.
fold_pure_initialization.forbidden_shortcut: The final all688 nonlinear-Z model may not initialize any OOF fold because it contains held-fold target exposure.
fold_pure_initialization.final_fit_rule: Only a post-gate all688 fit may initialize from the frozen final all688 nonlinear-Z model.

architecture.inherited_path: base_linear 42x64 + SiLU + trunk2 64x64 + SiLU + six scalar heads
architecture.new_path: message_linear 8x64 without bias plus six 64x7 extra heads
architecture.recurrence: Each scalar/extra state is transported through exact W and receiver Phi before the pointwise source update.
architecture.epoch0_copy: Copy the fold nonlinear-Z first42 trunk columns, trunk2, and scalar heads exactly; zero the message adapter and all extra heads.
architecture.epoch0_operation_order: Bypass the message adapter entirely and retain the original scalar source einsum and NumPy float64 Phi/W recurrence for held-score parity.

epoch0_gate.all688_each_fold: At all six suffix layers on all 688 cached rows, candidate scalar source must be torch.equal to the reconstructed fold nonlinear source and all extra sources must be exact zero.
epoch0_gate.held172_each_fold: Candidate epoch0 per-network MSE must match persisted nonlinear-Z OOF with maximum absolute difference at most 5e-20.
epoch0_gate.extra_seed_timing: Only after both parity checks pass, seed extra-head weights with deterministic Normal(0,2^-16); the inherited scalar output remains unchanged because the message adapter is still zero.

training.loss: normalized endpoint channel-zero MSE plus 0.05 times normalized six-layer channel-zero anchor

phase1.trainable: message_linear and seven-channel extra heads only

requirements: all fold reconstruction and epoch0 parity gates pass
candidate OOF relative gain versus nonlinear-Z is at least 0.25 percent
at least three of four fold means improve
paired-network gain z is at least 2
at least 55 percent of networks improve nonlinear-Z
every fold has at least 50 percent network wins
legacy protected40 OOF does not worsen
candidate raw is below the in-run recomputed native bank
at least 55 percent of networks beat the native bank
candidate raw times the structural C8-D3 multiplier beats D4 #328622 adjusted

outcome_law.scientific_fail: Persist result only and close this exact v2 recipe.
outcome_law.scientific_pass_absolute_fail: Persist one scientific all688 model; no submission claim.
outcome_law.all_accuracy_gates_pass: Persist one all688 model and prepare D3 integration, but root alone may package after exact literal meter and target-free full gate.

distinction_from_c8v1: C8v1 started channel zero at zero and after six epochs remained near the alpha-J baseline, worsening all four folds. C8v2 starts at the exact fold-pure nonlinear-Z prediction and tests only whether extra transported channels add value.
